basis: Observed complete desktop, portrait and landscape Discovery forward/reverse recordings, sidecars and 5-percent safety samples. Targets are fresh-pass capture cues, not claims that native percent is runtime progress.

milestones.label: M01
milestones.observedChange: The orthographic section gains perspective while the same floor plates, stair and glazing remain aligned.

milestones.label: M02
milestones.observedChange: The same opened three-level section acquires material, landscape and an orange CAD cut-plane annotation.

milestones.label: M03
milestones.observedChange: The eye-level camera approaches the open face and reads upper, entrance and lower rooms through the same cut.

milestones.label: M04
milestones.observedChange: The camera enters the entrance-level living space and turns toward its continuous stair.

milestones.label: M05
milestones.observedChange: The route reaches the upper study with its desk, book wall and section drawing.

milestones.label: M06
milestones.observedChange: The camera crosses the upper lounge beside the long glazed wall.

milestones.label: M07
milestones.observedChange: The mezzanine edge reveals the entrance-level living room and exterior below.

milestones.label: M08
milestones.observedChange: The camera descends the same stair toward the lower garden level.

milestones.label: M09
milestones.observedChange: The route crosses the lower lounge with its sofa, sideboard and garden-side light.

milestones.label: M10
milestones.observedChange: The camera enters the lower bedroom and reveals the garden through the glazed facade.

milestones.label: M11
milestones.observedChange: The route passes outside the lower glazed facade and reads the house from the garden.

milestones.label: M12
milestones.observedChange: The camera returns toward the entrance-level living room while the same art, stair and furniture remain recognizable.

milestones.label: M13
milestones.observedChange: The camera withdraws to a materialized section and the orange cut-plane annotation reappears.

milestones.label: M14
milestones.observedChange: The materialized section flattens into the original technical sheet and the ending editorial copy begins.

reverseSemanticStates: Discovery reverse shows the ending copy clear, sheet become a materialized section, the same spatial route traverse backward, and the opening sheet/hero return. No independent reverse-only spatial state established; A0/A1 comparison remains a separate verdict.
